content.title: La Capricciosa
about: La Capricciosa is a pinball project developed for a university physics assignment.
The main focus was implementing believable pinball interactions (flippers, bumpers, ball dynamics) using the Bullet3 physics library.
It served as a practical exercise in applying physics concepts to game feel and responsiveness.
features: Bullet3-based physics simulation for pinball gameplay
Interactive elements such as flippers and bumpers
Score-driven loop typical of classic pinball tables
learnings: Applying physics concepts to interactive gameplay
Balancing simulation accuracy with fun and responsiveness
